input_messages.content: Hi! I’d like to make some changes to my upcoming reservation, please.
Sure! My user ID is yara_garcia_1905 and the reservation ID is HXDUBJ.

I’d like to change my outgoing flight to a nonstop flight that departs the next day instead of my current date. Also, I want to move my return flight from SFO back by one day. Both flights should depart after 8am and before 9pm.
Yes, that’s correct! Please go ahead and check for those options.

Yes, those options work for me! Please go ahead and make the changes.

Also, just to confirm—will there be any change fees? I have insurance, and according to your website, the fees should be waived.

Thank you for confirming and for waiving the fees!

Actually, I’d also like to upgrade my ticket to business class and add 2 checked bags for both flights. Can you let me know if that’s possible, and how much it would cost? I’m willing to pay up to $200 for the upgrade and bags.
Yes, please go ahead and check the availability and pricing for business class and the 2 checked bags. Let me know the total cost before making any changes.

That’s more than I was hoping to spend. In that case, I’d like to upgrade just the outgoing flight (IAH to SFO) to business class and keep economy for the return. I still want to add 2 checked bags for both flights. Can you let me know the total cost for that?
That’s close enough—yes, please go ahead and make those changes! You can use my original payment method for the additional charges.
Oh, I see. In that case, I’ll just keep economy for both flights, but I still want to add 2 checked bags for each flight. Can you let me know the total cost for just adding the extra bags?
Yes, that works for me! Please add the extra bags and charge the $100 to my original payment method.
Great, thank you for your help! That’s all I needed.
